__note: RIVE CITY — authored semantic rename map for the app IIFE served as /_player/hosted.js, applied by tools/apply-names.mjs (PLAN §5). `app` keys are the chunk's program-scope (IIFE-body) bindings; values are the semantic names. The whole app is ONE minified IIFE, so this is the entire app surface. Targets are fresh across the chunk (the preflight refuses a collision) and every rule must fire on every eligible occurrence or the run is refused. Binary .riv payloads (file.riv, _player/drawer.riv) and the CDN rive.js runtime are never candidates — the .riv payloads are hashed notRendered records, the runtime stays CDN.
